original.target_description: Full original article not obtained. DOI landing page, Unpaywall, OpenAlex and LMU repository did not supply full paper. Author dissertation includes only an article citation placeholder, not the original paper.

replication.target_description: Replication gender discrimination task is described on printed pp.944–945; results on p.946 include a main effect of EMOTION and collectively reported nonsignificant group terms. PDF p.2 locator is introduction/methods, not a unique result.

notes: Gender-discrimination accuracy and reaction time each have multiple possible terms. Requested partial eta squared does not identify an outcome or factor term; no term selected arbitrarily. The authors’ overall emotion-recognition replication verdict was not substituted for a target-specific verdict on this response-time, control-task, or unidentified misclassification test. Replication contains AN and healthy-control groups, not a separate major-depression group. The original dissertation was retained separately as non-article provenance; original terminal miss records acquisition routes.
